description:
[Coaching catalogue] List the coaching-catalogue directories you can see (your merchant's own plus the platform-wide public ones). Start here to find a directory id, to pick a parent for a new one, or to walk the tree with `parent_tag`; `is_start_directory` marks the page the catalogue opens on. The custom Markdown page is not included — read it with get_catalogue_directory. Returns 25 at a time; page with `offset` while `pagination.has_more` is true.

Paginated list of the coaching-catalogue directories visible to you: your merchant's own, plus the platform-wide `public` ones unless you set include_public=false. Use it to find a directory id before updating one, to pick a `parent_tag`, or to walk the tree with `parent_tag`. The custom Markdown page is not included — fetch it per directory with catalogue-tag-get.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

filter_text.description: Case-insensitive search on the directory id, name and description.

include_public.description: Include the platform-wide `public` directories shared across merchants.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

mojito_language_code.description: Filter by language: directories whose default language or one of whose language versions is this one. Omit for all languages.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

parent_tag.description: Return only the directories nested directly under this one (its `tags_sub`), in the parent's own order. Combine with the other filters to narrow further.

status.description: Filter by lifecycle status. Omit to include every status you can see (deleted directories are never returned).

name: list_catalogue_directories

data.description: The catalogue directories for this page, ordered by id.

coach_plan.description: Coaching-plan stage, when the directory belongs to one.

description.description: Short description shown on the directory card.

has_content_page.description: True when the directory has a custom Markdown page. Read the Markdown itself with catalogue-tag-get.

id.description: Directory id — also the catalogue URL segment and the value referenced in a parent's `tags_sub`.

is_start_directory.description: True for the directory the merchant's catalogue opens on — the root to navigate down from.

languages.description: Every language the directory has, its default (`mojito_language_code`) first. Read a version with catalogue-tag-get (`translations`).

merchant_id.description: Owning merchant id. Null for a platform-wide directory.

merged_into.description: Set when this directory was folded into another as one of its language versions (it is archived; its URL redirects there).

tags_interview_set_filter.description: Tag filter selecting the coaching sessions this directory lists: a session appears when its own `tags` contain every tag here.

tags_sub.description: Ids of the directories nested under this one, in display order.

has_more.description: True when more records exist beyond this page (offset + returned < total).

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List coaching catalogue directories
